name: XRP VolFavorite
description: ETH VolFavorite (v2 code) applied unchanged to XRP: late in each 15-minute window, buy the side that is winning when the market prices much more volatility than a forecast from XRP's recent realized vol. The model and entry threshold are refit monthly on XRP's own history.
hypothesis: ETH's 15-minute market overprices short-horizon vol and the BTC market does not; the difference looks like efficiency (thinner, more retail markets misprice more). XRP's 15-minute market is smaller and more retail than ETH's, so the same overpricing should appear. The other side: traders paying up for the trailing side late in the window. Wrong if the walk-forward on XRP is flat or negative, or the edge appears only in one or two months.
